content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@ι,Type),Type.annotation(@hord,$\mathrm{LinearOrder}\ \iota$),Type.annotation(@f,Type.to(ι,V)),Type.annotation(@h,$\dim_{\mathbb{K}} V = \operatorname{card} \iota$),Type.annotation(@hIP,InnerProductSpace($\mathbb{K}$,V))),def(gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis(h,f),,$\mathrm{GSB}(h,f) \text{ is an orthonormal basis of } V \text{ agreeing with } \{\widehat{g}_n\} \text{ wherever that is nonzero}$))

values.zh-CN: 当 $\dim_{\mathbb{K}}V=|\iota|$ 时，`gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis h f` 给出 $V$ 的一组规范正交基，它在规范正交化族非零处与之相等。Lean 按 `gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis h f` 的次序接受两个显式参数：维数等式 `h` 与族 `f`。
values.en: When $\dim_{\mathbb{K}}V=|\iota|$, `gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis h f` yields an orthonormal basis of $V$ that agrees with the normalised Gram–Schmidt family wherever that family is nonzero. Lean takes the explicit arguments in the order `gramSchmidtOrthonormalBasis h f`: the dimension identity `h` and the family `f`.
